description: This Java class 'RecentCommands' manages a GUI component that displays and handles a list of recently used commands. It includes functionality to add commands to the list, persist them, create UI buttons for commands, and handle command execution. It also provides a button to read a trigger log CSV file and process it.

classes.name: RecentCommands
classes.description: A Java class that manages a GUI component for displaying recently used commands, allowing interaction through buttons, and providing functionality for command persistence and execution.

classes.name: RecentCommands.Entry
classes.description: A nested static class representing an individual command entry used in the recent commands list, with comparison capabilities.

methods.name: pack()
methods.description: Serializes current command list into a string for persistence.
